title: WorkPulse CDC change envelope v1
description: Debezium change envelope for one captured row change on `workpulse.cdc.<table>`. Captured columns are restricted to identifiers, state and timestamps (`.ai/security.md`); row shapes live under `contracts/cdc/rows/`.

before.description: Row image before the change (Debezium `before`). In delete/update events Debezium emits only the replica-identity columns, so `before` may be a filtered subset of the row schema. Null for create/read/truncate.

after.description: Row image after the change (Debezium `after`), matching the per-table row schema under `contracts/cdc/rows/`. Null for delete/truncate.

op.description: Operation: create, update, delete, snapshot read, truncate. The sink drops `d`/`t` and never deletes projection rows.

ts_ms.description: Debezium processing timestamp in epoch milliseconds. Projection versioning uses `source.ts_ms` instead — never ingest wall clock.

transaction.description: Optional Debezium transaction metadata; not used by the pipeline.

source.description: Debezium source metadata. Extra connector fields (version, connector, name, sequence, txId, xmin, ...) are allowed by design — the pinned fields are the pipeline contract.

ts_ms.description: Source transaction commit timestamp in epoch milliseconds — the projection row's `updated_at`.

lsn.description: PostgreSQL log sequence number of the change; the `(commit_ts, lsn)` tie-breaker fallback.

snapshot.description: Debezium snapshot marker: `true` for initial-snapshot rows, `last` for the final snapshot row, `false` when streaming. Null when the source does not report it.

schema.description: Source schema name (`public` for the WorkPulse OLTP tables).

table.description: Captured table; decides which row schema applies to `after`.
